name: Submerged bridge
note: Synthetic demonstration scenario. Not a reconstruction of any real flood event and not validated against observations. The deck height is read from a DSM surface at the bridge midpoint, so it approximates the canopy/road surface, not a surveyed deck.
selection_rule: longest bridge >=30 m that intersects the island outline and carries a primary/secondary/trunk road
known_gaps: The Majuli-Jorhat crossing is tagged highway=construction in OSM, so it is excluded here even though it is the island's main link. Scenarios therefore exercise river crossings that are already open.
expected_effects: the bridge edge disappears from every route
settlements on the far side gain at least one hop
closest reachable shelter changes for affected places
assertions: edge absent from all returned routes
route length/time is >= the baseline for every affected pair
affected settlements are reported explicitly rather than silently re-routed
